users.bio: South Indian home cook. Dosa evangelist. Jain recipes for my grandmother.
Punjabi kitchen, tandoor smoke and slow-cooked curries.
Wok hei chaser. Pan-Asian street food at home.
Pasta from scratch and sunny Mediterranean plates.

recipe.title: Masala Dosa
recipe.description: Crisp rice-lentil crepe with a spiced potato filling — Sunday breakfast in Chennai.
steps: Boil, peel and roughly mash the potatoes.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil; add onion and chilli and cook until soft.
Add turmeric, salt and potatoes; mix well to make the filling.
Spread a ladle of batter thinly on a hot tawa and drizzle oil around the edges.
When golden and crisp, add filling, fold and serve with chutney.

recipe.title: Jain Paneer Butter Masala
recipe.description: Rich, creamy gravy without onion or garlic — every bit as indulgent.
steps: Soak cashews in hot water for 15 minutes and blend to a smooth paste.
Melt butter, add tomato puree and cook until it thickens.
Stir in cashew paste, chilli powder, garam masala, sugar and salt.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with cream and crushed kasuri methi.

recipe.title: Moong Dal Chilla
recipe.description: Protein-packed savoury pancakes from soaked yellow moong.
steps: Grind soaked dal with chilli and a little water to a smooth batter.
Mix in cumin, coriander and salt.
Spread thin rounds on a hot greased tawa.
Cook both sides until golden and serve with chutney.

recipe.title: Lemon Rice
recipe.description: Tangy temple-style rice with peanuts — ready in minutes from leftover rice.
steps: Fry peanuts in oil until crunchy.
Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, chilli and turmeric.
Toss in the rice with salt.
Turn off the heat and squeeze in lemon juice.

recipe.title: Jain Dal Tadka
recipe.description: Comforting toor dal with a sizzling cumin and hing tempering.
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric and water for 3 whistles.
Heat ghee, add cumin, hing and chopped tomato.
Add chilli powder and pour the tadka over the dal.
Simmer 5 minutes and garnish with coriander.

recipe.title: Mango Lassi
recipe.description: Thick, chilled mango yogurt drink with a hint of cardamom.
steps: Peel and chop the mangoes.
Blend everything until smooth and frothy.
Serve chilled.

recipe.title: Butter Chicken
recipe.description: Smoky tandoori chicken in a velvety tomato-butter gravy.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger garlic paste, salt and garam masala for 30 minutes.
Sear or grill the chicken until charred.
Cook tomato puree in butter until glossy.
Add chicken and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and kasuri methi.

recipe.title: Chicken Biryani
recipe.description: Layered dum biryani with saffron rice and tender spiced chicken.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, biryani masala and mint.
Fry sliced onions in ghee until deep golden.
Par-boil rice with salt until 70% done.
Layer chicken, onions and rice; top with saffron milk.
Seal and cook on low heat for 25 minutes.

recipe.title: Tandoori Chicken
recipe.description: Oven-roasted chicken legs with a fiery yogurt marinade.
steps: Slash the chicken and rub with lemon and salt.
Coat in yogurt, tandoori masala, ginger garlic paste and oil; rest 1 hour.
Roast at 220°C for 30 minutes, turning once.
Char under the grill for 3 minutes and serve with onion rings.

recipe.title: Mutton Rogan Josh
recipe.description: Kashmiri slow-cooked mutton in a deep red, aromatic gravy.
steps: Brown the mutton in ghee in batches.
Cook onions, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add chilli and fennel; stir in whisked yogurt.
Return mutton, add water and simmer covered for 75 minutes.

recipe.title: Egg Bhurji
recipe.description: Spicy Indian scrambled eggs — the ultimate quick breakfast.
steps: Sauté onion, chilli and tomato in butter.
Add turmeric and salt.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until just set.

recipe.title: Garlic Naan
recipe.description: Soft, blistered flatbread brushed with garlic butter.
steps: Knead flour, yogurt, yeast and salt into a soft dough; rest 2 hours.
Roll into ovals and press on chopped garlic.
Cook on a very hot tawa, then flame directly for blisters.
Brush with melted butter.

recipe.title: Veg Hakka Noodles
recipe.description: Street-style wok-tossed noodles with crunchy vegetables.
steps: Boil noodles until al dente and rinse in cold water.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce and vinegar; toss well.
Finish with spring onion greens.

recipe.title: Prawn Fried Rice
recipe.description: Smoky wok fried rice with juicy prawns and egg.
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Sear prawns with garlic until pink.
Add rice and toss on high heat.
Season with soy sauce, fold in eggs and spring onion.

recipe.title: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
recipe.description: Fragrant coconut curry with tofu, aubergine and Thai basil.
steps: Fry curry paste and lemongrass in oil until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add brinjal and bamboo shoots; cook 8 minutes.
Add tofu, warm through and finish with basil.

recipe.title: Pad Thai
recipe.description: Sweet-sour-salty rice noodles with prawns, peanuts and lime.
steps: Soak noodles in warm water for 20 minutes.
Stir-fry prawns, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, tamarind and fish sauce; toss.
Fold in bean sprouts and serve with peanuts and lime.

recipe.title: Chicken Ramen
recipe.description: Rich chicken broth, springy noodles and a soy-marinated topping.
steps: Simmer stock with soy and miso for 15 minutes.
Poach the chicken in the broth and slice.
Cook noodles separately and drain.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, chicken, egg, nori and spring onion.

recipe.title: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
recipe.description: Maki rolls with cucumber, avocado and carrot.
steps: Cook rice and season with vinegar and sugar; cool.
Spread rice on nori over a sushi mat.
Line with vegetable strips and roll tightly.
Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy sauce.

recipe.title: Crispy Veg Spring Rolls
recipe.description: Golden rolls stuffed with stir-fried cabbage and carrot.
steps: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables with soy sauce; cool.
Fill and roll the sheets, sealing with flour paste.
Deep fry until golden and crisp.

recipe.title: Margherita Pizza
recipe.description: Neapolitan-style pizza with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
steps: Knead flour, yeast, salt and water; rise for 90 minutes.
Stretch the dough thin on a floured tray.
Spread sauce, top with torn mozzarella and oil.
Bake at the highest oven setting for 10–12 minutes; add basil.

recipe.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipe.description: Garlic, chilli and olive oil — the 15-minute Roman classic.
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water.
Gently fry sliced garlic and chilli in olive oil until pale gold.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley.

recipe.title: Penne Arrabbiata
recipe.description: Angry tomato sauce with garlic and chilli.
steps: Cook garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with cooked penne and basil.

recipe.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipe.description: Creamy arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Sauté mushrooms until golden and set aside.
Soften onion and garlic in butter; toast the rice.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Fold in mushrooms, parmesan and a knob of butter.

recipe.title: Greek Salad
recipe.description: Juicy tomatoes, cucumber, olives and feta with oregano.
steps: Chop vegetables into chunks.
Add olives and a slab of feta.
Dress with olive oil and oregano.

recipe.title: Hummus
recipe.description: Silky chickpea and tahini dip with lemon and garlic.
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic and cumin.
Stream in ice water until very smooth.
Serve drizzled with olive oil.

recipe.title: Shakshuka
recipe.description: Eggs poached in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce.
steps: Cook onion, capsicum and garlic in olive oil.
Add spices and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

recipe.title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
recipe.description: Roasted sweet potato, chickpeas and greens with tahini dressing.
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato and chickpeas for 20 minutes.
Cook quinoa.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water.
Assemble bowls and drizzle with dressing.

recipe.title: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
recipe.description: Tall, buttery pancakes for slow weekend mornings.
steps: Whisk dry ingredients together.
Whisk milk, egg and melted butter; fold into the dry mix.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered pan until bubbles form; flip.

recipe.title: Eggless Chocolate Cake
recipe.description: Moist, rich chocolate sponge made with curd — no eggs.
steps: Whisk curd, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Sift in flour, cocoa and baking soda; fold gently.
Bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes.
Cool before frosting.

recipe.title: Gulab Jamun
recipe.description: Soft khoya dumplings soaked in rose-cardamom syrup.
steps: Make syrup with sugar, water, cardamom and rose water.
Knead khoya and maida into a smooth dough; roll small balls.
Fry on low heat until deep brown.
Soak in warm syrup for 2 hours.

recipe.title: Banana Oat Smoothie
recipe.description: Creamy breakfast smoothie with peanut butter and dates.
steps: Add everything to the blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Masala Chai
recipe.description: Strong, milky tea simmered with ginger and cardamom.
steps: Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
Add tea leaves and simmer 2 minutes.
Add milk and sugar; bring to a rolling boil.
Strain and serve hot.

recipe.title: Tomato Basil Soup
recipe.description: Velvety roasted tomato soup with fresh basil.
steps: Cook onion and garlic in butter.
Add tomatoes and stock; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend with basil until smooth.
Swirl in cream to serve.

recipe.title: Fish and Chips
recipe.description: Crispy beer-style batter (with sparkling water) and thick-cut chips.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick chips and fry twice for crispness.
Whisk flour, baking powder and cold sparkling water into a batter.
Dip fish and fry until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and salt.

recipe.title: Full English Breakfast
recipe.description: Eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms and toast.
steps: Fry sausages and bacon until crisp.
Fry mushrooms and halved tomatoes in the same pan.
Warm the beans and fry the eggs.
Serve with buttered toast.

recipe.title: Chicken Tacos
recipe.description: Charred spiced chicken in warm tortillas with lime and sour cream.
steps: Rub chicken with cumin, chilli and lime; sear and slice.
Char capsicum and onion strips.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken, veg, lettuce and sour cream.

recipe.title: Veg Burrito Bowl
recipe.description: Rice, black beans, corn and avocado with zesty lime.
steps: Cook rice with a squeeze of lime.
Warm beans with cumin.
Make a quick salsa with tomato, coriander and lime.
Assemble bowls with corn and sliced avocado.

recipe.title: Chana Masala
recipe.description: Punjabi-style chickpeas in a tangy onion-tomato masala.
steps: Pressure cook chickpeas until soft.
Fry onions until brown; add ginger garlic paste and tomatoes.
Add chana masala and cook until oil separates.
Add chickpeas with some cooking water and simmer 10 minutes.

recipe.title: Hot and Sour Soup
recipe.description: Peppery, tangy soup loaded with vegetables.
steps: Bring vegetable stock or water to a boil with finely chopped vegetables.
Add soy sauce, vinegar and pepper.
Thicken with cornflour slurry.
Garnish with spring onion.
